in_sanskrit.name: Istekhar
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Wisdom
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Istekhar एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Istekhar is a Sanskrit name derived from the term 'Ista' meaning 'god' and 'Khar' meaning 'wisdom'. This name is believed to be associated with the Hindu deity Agastya, who is known as the God of Wisdom and Knowledge.
